profile.address: 1611 San Pablo Avenue, Suite 10 B, Berkeley, CA 94702
profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Berkeley, California, that supports teachers and science professionals in underserved communities. It connects scientists with elementary and middle school teachers and offers teaching resources and professional development so students can do hands-on science.

sources.title: Community Resources For Science - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: Exact name match to the Berkeley 501(c)(3) (EIN 94-3262587 on ProPublica) whose own site lists the same address, phone and email and describes East Bay TK-8 science teaching support, consistent with a no-cost academics agreement. Summary is neutral and supported by the homepage; the site does not mention OUSD, but name, city and service all fit.
